I designed the 100 experiments as paired contrasts. Each pair applies the same edit to parents that differ in one edge, so the parent edge's effect on the edit can be read directly. The pairs cover:
- edits on every edge, with the parent edge varied over none, skip, conv1x1, conv3x3 and avg-pool;
- the edge-3/edge-5 and edge-4/edge-5 skip-path interactions;
- edge-1 and edge-2 removal contexts, and edge-0 replacement contexts.
